title: Strawberry Almond Cream Tart
changes_from_base: A thin baked almond-paste cream under rings of fresh strawberries, instead of baked frangipane with poached pears.
summary: A crisp pastry case with a thin baked almond cream, covered in rings of fresh strawberries.
equipment: 23 cm tart tin or quiche dish

ingredients.item: plain flour, plus extra for rolling
fine sea salt or table salt
cold unsalted butter, in small pieces
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Pastry
steps.text: pulse the flour, salt and sugar, add the butter and pulse to pea-sized pieces. Pulse in the water just until the dough starts to clump, press it together, wrap and chill 30 min.

steps.title: Line and bake
steps.text: heat the oven to 180 °C (160 °C fan). Roll the dough 3 mm thick and fit it into the dish. Line with paper and beans and bake 25 min, then uncover and bake 2 min more.

steps.title: Almond cream
steps.text: process the almond paste and butter until smooth. Add the flour, sugar and salt, then the egg and vanilla, and blend until creamy.

steps.title: Bake again
steps.text: spread the almond cream evenly in the case and bake about 15 min, until set. Cool completely. Let the almond cream cool fully before adding the fruit.

steps.title: Strawberries
steps.text: starting at the edge, stand the halves in rings, cut sides facing out and leaning on the pastry, working inwards until covered.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: sift icing sugar over just before slicing. Dust just before serving, or the sugar dissolves into the berries.

tips: Pick strawberries of a similar size so the rings look even.
Almond paste is coarser and less sweet than marzipan; use almond paste here.
Assemble no more than 2 h before serving.
Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Best on the day. Chill leftovers for up to 1 day.
